facts: The café is at the end of Jeju Olle Trail 16 and opposite the start of Trail 17 in Gwangnyeong-ri, Aewol-eup.
It serves coffee and handmade milk tea, has a photo-printing machine and books for walkers to rest, and has no parking facility.
Jeju Olle lists Trail 16 as Gonae–Gwangnyeong and Trail 17 as Gwangnyeong–Kim Man-deok Memorial Hall.
Both routes are medium difficulty and are multi-hour walking routes.
The listing describes a photographer-operated café in front of the Gwangnyeong 1-ri office, at the Trail 16 end/Trail 17 start, with photo printing and handmade milk tea.
